name: Voice Logica AI for WooCommerce
author: John Raza

sections.description:
Voice Logica AI connects your WooCommerce store to Voice Logica AI Voice Agents, enabling your customers to interact with your store using natural voice commands — around the clock.

Features:

  • Voice-powered order creation
  • Product search by voice
  • Customer account lookup
  • Order history retrieval
  • Secure API key authentication
  • GDPR-ready with full privacy support

Once connected, your Voice Logica AI Voice Agent can handle common customer support tasks automatically, reducing workload and improving customer experience.

Third-party / External Services

This plugin relies on Voice Logica AI (https://www.voicelogica.ai), an external service that powers AI Voice Agents for your store. By using this plugin, your WordPress site will communicate with Voice Logica AI servers.

What the service is and what it is used for:
Voice Logica AI provides voice-powered customer support. When you connect your store, the plugin sends connection data and feature settings to Voice Logica AI’s servers. Voice Logica AI’s Voice Agents then use your WooCommerce REST API (via securely stored credentials) to perform actions such as searching products, retrieving order history, and creating orders—on behalf of your customers, via voice.

What data is sent and when:
* On Connect: Site URL, store name, store address, country, admin email, admin name, and WooCommerce API credentials (consumer key and secret) are sent to Voice Logica AI to establish the connection.
* When saving settings: Site URL, admin email, and enabled feature flags (e.g., order creation, product search) are sent to keep Voice Logica AI in sync with your preferences.
* During voice interactions: Voice Logica AI calls your WooCommerce REST API directly (from their servers to your site) using the stored credentials, so customer and order data flows between your site and Voice Logica AI when handling voice requests.

Legal and privacy information:
* Terms of Service: https://www.voicelogica.ai/en/terms
* Privacy Policy: https://www.voicelogica.ai/en/privacy-policy
* AI Policy: https://www.voicelogica.ai/en/ai-policy
* Data Processing Agreement: https://www.voicelogica.ai/en/dpa-en
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/voicelogica-ai-for-woocommerce directory, or install through the WordPress plugin screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to WooCommerce > Voice Logica AI and connect your store to Voice Logica AI.
sections.faq:
Do I need a Voice Logica AI account?

Yes. You will need an active Voice Logica AI account and API key to use this plugin. Visit voicelogica.ai to sign up.

Does this plugin work without WooCommerce?

No. WooCommerce must be installed and active for this plugin to function.

Is customer data sent to Voice Logica AI servers?

Only the data needed to fulfil voice requests (such as order lookups) is transmitted. Please review our Privacy Policy at voicelogica.ai for full details.

Which WooCommerce version is supported?

WooCommerce 5.0 and above is supported.
